On the defence side I would always ask doctors preparing medical reports specific questions about weight. "Could this claimant recover/improve with sustained weight loss" "are there any impediments to the claimant losing weight" "in your opinion, has the claimant taken all reasonable measures, including weight loss and rehabilitation, to improve their condition".

Although, I did often tell Plaintiff clients not to do too much because if they go to the gym or take the rubbish out or carry the groceries in from the car or anything like that you can almost guarantee there will be a PI watching them and the video of it will be played at trial. Show them a video of your client walking in and out of a gym and that's hard to come back from.
